verdict.rationale: Deepgram Voice Agent documents telephony connectivity for inbound and outbound calls, a Twilio audio bridge, and generic function calling. Nothing in the evidence shows sending DTMF keypresses, navigating IVR menus, or detecting or leaving voicemail. Function calling is only a developer building block and Twilio is a host platform, so neither earns credit for this applicable telephony axis.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can send DTMF keypresses, navigate IVR menus, and detect or leave voicemail
